verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD with new songs, a hymn of praise in the midst of the righteous.
verses.2: Israel shall rejoice in its deeds. The children of Zion will praise their king.
verses.3: Let them praise His name in the valleys and on the hills. Let them sing His praises.
verses.4: For Jehovah desires to bless his people with salvation.
verses.5: The righteous will be honored and praised for their good deeds.
verses.6: They destroyed their homes and caused great destruction in their midst.
verses.7: To take revenge on those nations who are arrogant and wicked.
verses.8: They shall be bound with ropes when they are old, and their bodies shall be tied up with ropes.
verses.9: To carry out their laws is the judgment written by God for all his faithful ones. Praise be to Him!
